rows.grounds: emphatic particle indicating concession or inclusion
refers to the lord or consort
denotes the act or state of standing or abiding
free from hostility; continues description from previous verse

items.question: How does the goddess triumph without enmity while standing upon the lord's head?
premises: The goddess stands upon the head of the lord.
The goddess remains without enmity in this position.
Absence of enmity accompanies her prevailing state.
items.inference: Therefore the goddess triumphs without enmity even while standing upon the lord's head.
uncertainties: Whether śiraḥ sthityā implies physical placement or a symbolic hierarchical relation is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Even while standing on the lord's head, the goddess, free from enmity, triumphs.
